verdict.rationale: Paystack's own marketing says it can collect recurring payments, which covers the core of recurring billing only thinly. Nothing in the pack documents plans, trial periods, upgrades/downgrades, or proration. Missing for 10: documented plan/subscription objects, trial configuration, upgrade/downgrade handling, proration logic, in-depth API docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Collect one-time and recurring payments from your app or website
